data.to:
Wire up DRF TokenAuthentication so the payload ingest endpoint (HDT-7) can require a token. PROMPT.md: 'There should be basic Token authentication in this payload.'

Scope: add 'rest_framework.authtoken' to INSTALLED_APPS, add a REST_FRAMEWORK settings dict with DEFAULT_AUTHENTICATION_CLASSES = TokenAuthentication and DEFAULT_PERMISSION_CLASSES = IsAuthenticated (secure by default — the ingest view then needs no per-view auth config), run the authtoken migration, and document token creation in README.md (manage.py drf_create_token <username>, requests send 'Authorization: Token <key>').

Decision context: use DRF's built-in TokenAuthentication rather than JWT or a custom header — PROMPT.md says 'basic Token authentication' and built-in is the least surprising choice for a reviewer setting this up locally. Defaulting the whole API to IsAuthenticated is deliberate: it means a future view cannot accidentally ship unauthenticated.

Out of scope: the endpoint itself (HDT-7), user/device provisioning UI, token rotation, per-device tokens.

Note: HDT-5 deliberately left authtoken and the REST_FRAMEWORK dict out of settings so this task owns them.

data.body: Implemented per plan in commit 5c5afde: added rest_framework.authtoken to INSTALLED_APPS and REST_FRAMEWORK dict (TokenAuthentication + IsAuthenticated only) in app/config/settings.py; appended API authentication section to README.md (migrate/createsuperuser/drf_create_token, Authorization: Token header, docker + local). Verified: manage.py check clean, makemigrations --check --dry-run 'No changes detected' (DB-connection RuntimeWarning is environmental, no local postgres on 5432), both configured classes import. Note: the MM working-tree state flagged in the plan had already been committed by a sibling session (b53e589/60a61c1) before I started — tree was clean, psql line preserved.

Cold review of 5c5afde against plan. Verified: manage.py check clean; makemigrations --check --dry-run reports no changes (DB-connection RuntimeWarning is environmental, no local Postgres); settings.REST_FRAMEWORK contains exactly DEFAULT_AUTHENTICATION_CLASSES=[TokenAuthentication] and DEFAULT_PERMISSION_CLASSES=[IsAuthenticated]; rest_framework.authtoken in INSTALLED_APPS with its 4 bundled migrations discoverable via MigrationLoader (showmigrations itself requires a DB connection); commit touches only README.md and app/config/settings.py — no endpoint/view/url/serializer code, no in-repo migration files; drf_create_token command confirmed present (manage.py help drf_create_token); README documents migrate + createsuperuser + drf_create_token + 'Authorization: Token <key>' for docker compose and local, and the pre-existing psql line is intact. Only nit: README still lacks a trailing newline (pre-existing, not introduced here). Verdict: PASS. No rework needed.
